import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Get S6 trips data
trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Calculate daily averages by class
daily_stats = s6_trips.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

daily_stats['yt_per_angler'] = daily_stats['yt'] / daily_stats['anglers']

# Focus on THREE_QUARTER which was the main class
three_quarter = daily_stats[daily_stats['cls'] == 'three_quarter'].sort_values('fished_date_doy')

# Calculate rolling average
three_quarter_sorted = three_quarter.sort_values('fished_date_doy').reset_index(drop=True)
three_quarter_sorted['rolling_7d'] = three_quarter_sorted['yt_per_angler'].rolling(7, center=True).mean()

# Print critical periods
print("=== S6 THREE_QUARTER RATES BY DAY OF YEAR ===\n")

# Spring period
print("SPRING (DOY 100-140):")
spring = three_quarter_sorted[(three_quarter_sorted['fished_date_doy'] >= 100) & (three_quarter_sorted['fished_date_doy'] <= 140)]
if len(spring) > 0:
    print(spring[['fished_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler', 'rolling_7d']].to_string())
    print(f"Spring avg: {spring['yt_per_angler'].mean():.3f}")

print("\n" + "="*50 + "\n")

# Summer peak
print("SUMMER PEAK (DOY 170-200):")
summer = three_quarter_sorted[(three_quarter_sorted['fished_date_doy'] >= 170) & (three_quarter_sorted['fished_date_doy'] <= 200)]
if len(summer) > 0:
